name: Bhagavad Gita 7.16
text:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥
meaning: Four kinds of good people turn to me, Arjuna: the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the one who seeks some good, and the wise.
purpose: People approach the divine from distress, curiosity, desire or wisdom; useful for recognising different motivations without judgement.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
